profile.description: Junior Developer. Passionate about new technologies, especially the ecosystem of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. My goal is to achieve a high level of knowledge in web technologies and to apply them in the field of programming through best practices.

experience.first-job-description: In May 2024, I participated in the development of a web system for the educational center 30073 San Pedro de Yauyo, Chupaca, serving as a Front End designer, using Figma as a prototyping tool for the user interfaces. This experience allowed me to gain a more comprehensive understanding of software development, where the goal is not only to provide the most optimal logic for good performance but also to work from a client perspective, focusing on the aesthetics and intuitive handling of web systems.

hobbies.first-hobbies-description: I like riding a bicycle because it allows me to explore new places and enjoy the outdoors. I have visited several parks and trails by bike and have enjoyed the challenge of overcoming obstacles and improving my cycling skills. Riding a bicycle is a way I stay active and healthy, and I love the feeling of freedom and the thrill of speed.

projects.first-project-description: This week I learned to use Emmet, a tool that speeds up the writing of HTML and CSS code through abbreviations. I discovered how to generate complete structures with just a few characters, making interface development easier and improving my productivity in the code editor.
projects.second-project-description: During this week, I learned the fundamentals of HTML, understanding its basic structure, the correct use of semantic tags, and how a web page is built. Additionally, I explored the DOM (Document Object Model) and understood how it represents the hierarchical structure of HTML elements, allowing for manipulation from the browser.
projects.third-project-description: This week I learned to use CSS to style web pages, understanding how to apply colors, fonts, margins, and spacing. I also explored the use of selectors to target styles to specific elements, and studied Flexbox as a powerful tool for creating responsive designs and precise alignments in a page layout.
projects.fourth-project-description: This week I delved into the JavaScript language, learning its basic syntax and how to use control structures such as conditionals and loops to control the flow of the program. Additionally, I understood the principles of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), creating objects, classes, and methods that allow for more efficient organization and reuse of code.
projects.fifth-project-description: During this week I learned about React, a JavaScript library designed to build user interfaces efficiently and modularly. I learned the basics such as components, JSX, and state management, understanding how React facilitates the creation of dynamic and reusable web applications through a component-based structure.
projects.ten-project-description: This week I explored web development using Spring, a powerful Java framework that facilitates the creation of structured and scalable web applications. I learned to set up controllers, manage routes, and connect backend logic with dynamic views, understanding how Spring follows the MVC (Model-View-Controller) pattern to organize code in a modular and efficient way.
projects.thirteen-project-description: This week I learned to work with Laravel, a modern and robust PHP framework that facilitates the backend development of web applications. I got to know its MVC-based structure, the use of routes, controllers, and migrations to manage databases, as well as the creation of secure and scalable functionalities using Artisan commands and Eloquent ORM.
projects.fourteen-project-description: This week I learned how to develop web applications using Flask, a lightweight and flexible Python microframework for the backend. I understood how to create routes, handle HTTP requests, and render templates with Jinja2. Additionally, I explored the integration of forms and databases, which allowed me to build dynamic and functional applications quickly and in an organized manner.
projects.fifteen-project-description: During this week, I developed intelligent systems by combining tools such as Python, Flask, Django, and language models like LLaMA. I learned to integrate web interfaces with natural language processing capabilities, generating automatic and dynamic responses. Additionally, I explored the architecture of intelligent projects with a robust backend and AI-based services, consolidating knowledge about APIs, routes, templates, and deploying intelligent web applications.
